name: Tacos El Güero
description: The authentic taste of Mexico, fuel your victories!
story: Tacos El Güero, a family-owned taqueria chain based in Mexico City, has been serving up traditional flavors for over 30 years. Passionate about their community and Mexican culture, they see motorsport as a perfect platform to connect with fans and showcase the vibrant spirit of Mexico. They seek a partnership that celebrates Mexican heritage and delivers thrilling racing action.
